title: Feedback wanted: non-custodial automated Spot trading through the Kraken API
author: Altruistic-Fix6061
selftext:
I’ve been working on an automated Spot trading system using the Kraken API and I’d like to get some technical feedback from experienced Kraken users.

The basic idea is that the system never takes custody of the user’s funds. The capital remains in the user’s Kraken account and the API does not require withdrawal permissions.

The system only has the permissions necessary to execute Spot trades according to predefined rules designed to take advantage of market price fluctuations.

Every operation can be tracked individually: buys, sells, entry and exit prices, open positions, realized P/L and historical performance.

There is no leverage involved and therefore no leveraged liquidation risk. Of course, Spot trading still involves market risk and positions can lose value.

I’m particularly interested in feedback about the architecture:

• Would you be comfortable connecting this type of system to your Kraken account if withdrawal permissions were disabled?    
• What information would you expect to see before trusting an automated trading system?    
• Which API security measures would you consider essential?    
• What metrics would you want available in the dashboard?

The goal at this stage is to validate the architecture and understand what experienced Kraken users would consider necessary before using something like this with real funds.

Any technical criticism is welcome.
